title: Mukesh & Anr. v. State for NCT of Delhi (Nirbhaya Gang Rape & Homicide)
crime_type: Aggravated Gang Rape / Fatal Assault / Robbery
court_or_authority: Supreme Court of India / High Court of Delhi / Fast Track Court Saket
source: Supreme Court of India Official Judgment & Indian Kanoon (doc/144606771)
location: Munirka & Mahipalpur Highway, New Delhi, India
evidence: Forensic DNA profiling matching blood stains and epithelial tissue retrieved from bus interior to victim and accused with statistical certainty
Odontology forensic analysis establishing bite mark impressions on victim body corresponding to dentition of accused
Cellular tower Call Data Records (CDR) mapping the route of the chartered bus (DL 1PC 0149) across South Delhi highways
Recovery of victim's stolen mobile handset and ATM cards from the possession of accused
Dying declarations recorded by SDM and judicial magistrate corroborating the sequence of events
CCTV footage from toll plazas and highway hotels identifying the bus passing at specified timestamps
modus_operandi: Operated an illegally chartered private bus after hours. Picked up passengers seeking public transit at Munirka bus stand. Isolated victims inside the moving vehicle with darkened windows, overpowered male companion with iron rods, subjected female victim to extreme physical and sexual assault, robbed belongings, and ejected victims onto the roadside.
personality_disorder: Forensic behavioral profiling identified collective antisocial behavior, extreme predatory opportunism, absence of empathy, and group escalation of violence under alcohol influence.
common_traits: Impersonation of legitimate public transit services
Predatory isolation of stranded night commuters
Use of blunt metallic weapons (iron wheel-jack rods)
Ejection of victims on desolate highway strips to evade apprehension
Attempted destruction of vehicle biological evidence by washing with detergent
summary: Landmark Indian criminal jurisprudence case resulting in unanimous Supreme Court affirmation of capital punishment. Set global forensic standards for multi-parameter biological DNA profiling, forensic odontology, and rapid CCTV route reconstruction in transit-based crimes.
